synthetic_policy: Synthetic operational rows carry is_synthetic=true and provenance where the destination schema exposes those columns.
notes: Public entity seed contracts are validated with opticargo-shared==1.0.0.
Gateway-only persistence fields such as optimistic-lock version, cargo listing certifications and booking ownership/reference are derived deterministically at seed time.
Runtime presentation scenarios add five guaranteed-match UMKM listings without mutating the canonical JSON artifacts.
Distributor presentation scenario adds a deterministic supplier, five guaranteed-match listings, and five related booking states.
Optional small/medium/large load profiles expand users, suppliers, voyages, capacities, cargo listings and bookings deterministically for local FE/API performance testing.
Payments/recommendations/audit/outbox/session rows are intentionally not seeded directly; they are produced by Gateway/worker flows.
